verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents concrete autonomous background automation: Scheduled Flags apply changes at a future time without manual intervention, and Release Pipelines define stages with triggers/actions that automatically progress rollouts to environments/audiences, generating change requests on promotion. The MCP server also lets AI agents programmatically drive these flows, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live (though key-gated, un-exercised end-to-end). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that Release Pipelines actually execute staged autonomous rollouts in practice, and a verified authenticated MCP-driven automation run rather than just a 401 probe.
